text:
They want to know how many centimeters are in one inch.
How many cm in an inch?
inch to cm
What is an inch in metric?
Tell me how long an inch is in centimeters.
I only have a metric ruler, so what is an inch on it?
How big is one inch if I measure in centimeters?
Could you please tell me how many centimeters make up one inch? My phone battery is almost dead, and I have to drop my sizes off at the local shop before it closes.

An air conditioner keeps a room cool when the weather is hot. People mostly change three things: the temperature, the fan speed and the timer. To make a room cooler they say, make it colder, or, set it to twenty degrees. If the air feels too strong they say, turn the fan down. Some people divide the day in two, with a cool bedroom at night and a warmer house while they are out. A pale curtain helps keep the sun out, and a cold room feels like the inside of a fridge where a potato stays fresh. To stop the cooling, people say, switch it off, or, turn the cooling off at ten.

A smart lock opens and closes a front door without a key. It is for safety, and for letting the right people in. People change who can come in, when the door locks by itself, and whether it is locked right now. They say, lock the front door, is the door locked, or, let the dog walker in until five. A polite visitor rings the bell, and a small camera shows who is there. If you wish to stop a guest from coming in, you ask the assistant to take away their code. A lost key can mean a trip to the shop for a refund or a new copy, but a lost code is easy: you just ask for a new one.

name: get_headlines
does: Finds the newest news stories about a topic and reads out the top few, with repeats removed so the list stays clean.
inputs: the topic, and how many stories you want
people say:
- what's in the news today
- anything new about the dollar
- read me the sports results from last night
- catch me up before my working day starts
- what happened in town this morning

Rosa was making soup when she saw that the kitchen bin was full. She spoke to her phone. "Could you please tell me when the recycling truck comes? I would like to put the bins out in good time, because last week I missed it and the boxes piled up in the hall." The assistant looked up her street and said the truck comes on Thursday morning, which was tomorrow. Rosa then asked it to explain what goes in the green bin. The assistant said clean glass, cans and paper go in the green bin, and food scraps go in the compost. It also set a reminder for Wednesday at eight in the evening. Last, it told her the recycling center is a mile from her house, for anything too big for the bin.

Person: can you book movrs for saturday
Assistant: Yes. What time on Saturday, and what address are you moving from?
Person: 9am from 14 elm road. i have a heavy piano
Assistant: Thank you. Is the piano on the ground floor, or will the movers need to carry it up stairs?
Person: ground floor. my neighbor wants to sell me his old trolley, do you think i need one
Assistant: The movers bring their own trolley, so you can say no. I will book nine in the morning on Saturday for 14 Elm Road.
Person: also call the power company and tell them i'm moving
Assistant: I can't call the power company for you, sorry. I can set a reminder for Friday so you remember to call them yourself.

A focus timer helps you work for a short time and then rest. A common plan is twenty-five minutes of work and then five minutes of break. People use it when they have a whole pile of jobs and cannot decide where to start. They change the length of the work time, the length of the break and the number of rounds. They say, set a timer for twenty minutes, make my breaks longer, or, start another round. A break is for standing up, drinking water and letting your eyes look at something far away. If you have a cough or feel tired, you might say, stop the timer and end the day early.

Mina was ten years old and hungry after school. Her mom was still at work, so Mina spoke to the tablet in the kitchen. "Please, could you order a cheese pizza from Tony's? My mom said it is fine, and my friend Sam is a student at the high school who is coming to help me with homework, so we need enough for two." The assistant said it understood: one large cheese pizza from Tony's, to be delivered to her address. It said her mom would have to say yes to the payment first. Mina asked it to switch the order to two small pizzas, and the assistant changed it. It told her delivery would take about thirty minutes, and it sent a message to her mom asking her to approve the order.

Dan was pouring cereal for the kids when he remembered the Sunday ride. "Find me a flat bike route by the river and tell me how far it is," he said to his phone. The assistant found a loop along the river path and said it is eighteen kilometers long. Dan said it sounded good, and the assistant saved the route and tagged it family ride. Then he asked about a new bike light, but the first ones he saw were pricey, so he told the assistant to forget it for now. The assistant dropped the search. It also set a reminder for Saturday night to charge the bike lights, so the kids would be ready in the morning.

name: check_water_bowl
does: Tells you if your pet's water bowl is full, and warns you when the water outside has turned icy, so you know what happened to it.
inputs: the pet's name, and whether the bowl is inside or outside
people say:
- is the dog's water low
- did the cat's bowl freeze overnight
- I'm watching a movie, can you check if Max has water
- is there still water for the rabbit
- tell me if the outside bowl needs a refill

name: plan_workout
does: Makes a short workout with a few exercises, sets and reps, based on the time you have and the part of the body you want to train.
inputs: how many minutes you have, which muscles or goal, and what equipment you own
people say:
- give me a quick routine for my arms
- I only have twenty minutes, what should I do
- my colleague showed me a plank, set me up with something like that
- plug in a leg day I can do at home
- I want a workout with no weights

They want to book a repair visit for a broken dishwasher.
Fix my dishwasher, please.
I need a repair person for the dishwasher.
Get someone to look at my broken dishwasher.
Can you book a visit? It is leaking again.
It stopped halfway through the wash, so find a technician who can come this week.
Please book a repair for the dishwasher, and unmute my phone so I hear it when they call.
I hate to be rude, but yogurt got stuck in the pump and the machine has not worked for twenty-five days, so I would like the first visit you can find.

Person: The speaker is too quiet. Make it louder, please. My grandfather can't hear it.
Assistant: Of course. Which speaker, the kitchen one or the living room one?
Person: The living room one. Make it lovely and loud, like twenty-five.
Assistant: The volume only goes up to ten. Shall I set it to eight?
Person: Yes, please.
Assistant: Done, the living room speaker is at eight. Would you like me to arrange the kitchen speaker to play the same song?
Person: No, thank you. This is enough.

The inbox is where new email arrives. It is for reading messages, writing back and keeping the letters you need. People change what they see: only unread mail, mail from one person, or mail with an attachment. They say, show my unread mail, find the email from Sam, or, write back and say I'll know by Friday. A photo of your garden can be an attachment, but a huge file may be too big to send, so people ask to make it smaller first. When mail piles up they say, delete the old ones, or, mark everything as read.

Mr. Alvarez, a retired teacher, stood on the sand with his phone in a plastic bag. It was early and the sea looked cold. "How warm is the water today? Is it warmer than yesterday?" he asked. The assistant said the water was eighteen degrees, which is two degrees warmer than yesterday. Then he asked how often he should put on sun cream, and the assistant said every two hours, and twice as often after swimming. The waves were loud, so he turned up the speaker on his phone. Last, he asked the assistant to call his wife and say he would swim for half an hour. The assistant made the call and left the message.

name: play_voicemail
does: Plays the voice messages people left on your phone, newest first, and says who called and when, so you are ready to call back.
inputs: which messages you want (new or all), and a caller's name if you only want one person
people say:
- any messages for me
- I'm getting ready to ride my motorcycle, did anyone leave a message
- who called while I was out
- let me hear what mom said
- load the new voicemails

Priya came home after a night shift, too tired to hurry. She leaned on the door and asked her phone, "Could you please check if my parcel has come? I am waiting for my medicine, and I am too tired to walk down to the mailbox if it is not there yet." The assistant looked at the tracking page and said the parcel had been left in the mailbox at nine that morning. It said the parcel was a thick envelope and that no signature was needed. Priya thanked it, and the assistant also set a reminder for four in the afternoon, to take the medicine with food.

Omar was putting on his coat. He had no time to fry eggs that morning, and the dog sat by the door looking bored. "Turn the alarm on, but don't turn off the hallway camera," he said to the speaker. "And I don't want the porch light on, it's daytime." The assistant said it understood: the alarm was on, the hallway camera was still recording, and the porch light stayed off. It also said the front door was locked. Omar asked about the spare key under the stone by the gate, but the assistant said it could not see that. Omar laughed, picked up his bag and ran for the bus.

A video meeting lets people who are in different places talk together. It is for planning, sharing news and getting work done. Before it starts, someone writes an agenda, which is a short list of what to talk about. A shared screen lets everyone see the same thing, like a plain list or a picture of a bike wheel. People change who can talk, whether the camera is on, and what is shown on the screen. They say, join my two o'clock call, share my screen, mute me, or, fill in the agenda with the budget. When the meeting is over they say, leave the call.

A score keeper helps players of a board game or card game remember who is winning. Games have rules, and a timer can show how long each turn takes. People change the number of players, the time on the clock and the points they give. They say, start a game for four, set the timer to one minute, give Ana five points, or, whose turn is it. In a farm card game, a milk card might be worth three points. In a shop game, a player can charge another player rent. When the game is over, people ask, who got the right answers, or, read me the final scores.

name: set_walk_reminder
does: Reminds you when it is time to walk your dog, so a tired owner does not forget.
inputs: the dog's name, the time, and which days
people say:
- remind me to walk Rex at six
- the girl next door says the dog barks at five, can you nudge me
- I think the dog needs a walk soon
- ping me every evening for the dog
- when did we last go out

Person: Tell the kids a story and dim the lights, please.
Assistant: Happy to do both. Which story, and how long should the lights stay dim?
Person: The bear one. Half an hour. I have to go and grill the fish.
Assistant: Starting the bear story now. The lights in the kids' room are dim for thirty minutes.
Person: Can you also tell me if the doctor called? The sky is cloudy, so there are no stars to show the children anyway.
Assistant: I can't read messages from the doctor's office, but I can show you your missed calls. Would you like that?
Person: Yes, please.

Hana was in her humid kitchen, stirring a stew, when she remembered the delivery. "Track order," she said. The assistant checked and said her new pan was out for delivery, due by five o'clock. A cooking stream was playing on the tablet, and the assistant turned it down so she could hear. Hana added, "Tell the driver to ring twice." The assistant put the note on her order. It also said the driver would need the key code for the building gate, and asked if it should send it. Hana said yes, and the assistant sent the code to the driver.

A baby monitor lets parents hear or see a baby who is asleep in another room. It is for knowing when the baby wakes, and for keeping feeding times and nap times in order. Parents change the volume, switch on night mode and set reminders. They say, turn the monitor louder, remind me to feed her at six, or, wake me if she cries. Many keep personal notes on what the baby ate, like pieces of fruit that were peeled and mashed. A baby with little hair may still need a hat when it is cold. Parents also say, how long did she sleep, or, start the nap timer.

Tara was lying under the bathroom sink, fixing a faucet, when her little son called out a homework question. She spoke to her phone. "What is forty-eight divided by six?" The assistant understood it as a division and said eight. "And what is half of that?" she asked. The assistant said four. Tara said her son's next question was twice as hard, so she asked, "What is seven times nine?" The assistant answered sixty-three. Then she asked it to create a note: buy twice as many pencils. The assistant made the note and put it at the top of her shopping list.

name: days_until
does: Counts how many days are left until a date, or since a date, and can rank several dates by which comes first.
inputs: a date or the name of an event, and optionally a list of other dates
people say:
- how long until my birthday
- how many sleeps till the holiday
- which comes first, the party or the trip
- countdown to Friday
- how many days until my next lesson, it feels weird to lose count

They want to restart a frozen computer without losing their files.
Restart my computer but keep my files.
reboot, don't delete anything
The screen is stuck. Please restart it, but don't wipe anything.
Turn it off and on again, nothing else.
I don't understand why it froze, so just restart it and leave my folders alone.
The screen has been acting rough all day, so could you please restart the computer so the printer connects again? I do not want to erase or move any of my files.

Buses and trains run on timetables, which say when each one leaves each stop. A timetable is for planning a trip so you do not wait too long. When a bus or train is late, that is called a delay. People change the stop they leave from, the time they want to go and which line they take. They say, when is the next train to the ocean, is the number nine bus late, or, find a station with a lift. On a bitter cold morning, many people ask, are the trains running, before they leave the house.

They want an idea for a birthday gift for their mother.
Gift ideas for mom?
What should I get my mom?
I need a present for my mother, nothing boring.
Suggest something for her birthday that isn't flowers.
Help me pick a gift, something she can touch and use, not just a card.
She is hard to shop for, and I'm a hundred percent sure she does not want a candle.
Her constant complaint is that she has too much stuff, so please give me ideas that are not scarves or mugs.

Jay was on the bus heading east, texting his phone fast. He was planning a party and wanted to invite twelve friends, with seven pieces of candy for each. He typed: "how mcuh is 12 times 7". The assistant understood it as the question how much is twelve times seven, and it answered eighty-four. Jay then wrote "ok thats a lot of candy," and asked for half of that. The assistant said forty-two. Jay decided to buy forty-two pieces and tell his friends to bring their own.

They want a reminder about a friend's birthday.
Remind me about Sam's birthday.
Don't let me forget Sam's birthday on Friday.
Ping me tomorrow at seven about the party.
I want a reminder before my journey on Saturday, so I can buy Sam a card first.
Set a bright alert on my screen for Sam's birthday.
Could you tell me tomorrow at seven that Sam's birthday is this week?
Would you please nudge me the day before, since I want to bring a gift?

A ticket is your proof that you can ride a bus or train. It is for paying the fare, and some tickets are good for one trip and some for a whole day. Young children often ride free or pay half, and older people may have a cheaper fare too. People change the kind of ticket, how many people it is for and the day it starts. They say, buy a day pass, two tickets for tomorrow, or, a ticket for my daughter. The stop for the museum lies two blocks past the library, and the app keeps a record of your trips so you can see what you paid.

Ben, a student, was doing his fraction homework with the radio on low. The song that came on was not one he cared for. "Change station," he said to his speaker. The assistant understood he wanted a different radio station and switched to the news station he usually listens to. The news was about the weather, which was fine. After a minute Ben said, "Volume up," and the assistant made the sound a little louder. Then he got back to his fractions, with the usual voice of the news reader in the background.

They want the robot mower to start cutting the grass now.
Start mowing.
Mow the lawn.
Can the robot cut the grass now?
Get the mower going, it's an easy job.
I'd like the lawn cut before the rain comes, so please send the mower out.
Let the robot out for a run, I don't want to touch a button.
Check the battery balance on the mower and then get it going on the front lawn.

Person: when does my flight leave
Assistant: Which flight is it? Can you tell me the flight number, or the city you are going to?
Person: the one to lisbn tomorrow
Assistant: Thank you. Your flight to Lisbon leaves tomorrow at 7:40 in the morning from gate 12, which is in the green zone of the terminal.
Person: ok, i'll scroll through my email to find the check-in time. i only packed lettuce wraps for lunch lol
Assistant: Check-in opens about three hours before the flight. Would you like a reminder for tomorrow at 4:30?
Person: yes please

Luca was a teenager who worked on weekends at a shop that sells boots. His phone buzzed: the staff call was about to start. He texted his assistant, "Could you please open the meeting link for the staff call and share my screen with the sales sheet? I'm a little late, and my manager said she would wait for me." The assistant opened the link from his calendar and joined the call. Then it shared his screen with the sales sheet, as he asked. It told him it had joined with the camera off and his microphone muted, and Luca said that was fine.

Nina ran for the door with a cookie in her hand. "Make a note," she said to her phone. "Get double the milk this week, and half the sugar." The assistant answered in a polite voice that it understood. It wrote one note that said buy twice as much milk and half as much sugar as last time, and it saved the note to her shopping list. Nina also asked for one more pair of socks to be put on the list, and the assistant did that too. Then she shut the door and went to work.

Person: Set a timer for the stew. Keep it short, I'm driving.
Assistant: How many minutes should the timer run?
Person: I want the stew ready tomorrow at seven. I need to see the recipe when I park.
Assistant: The recipe says the stew needs three hours of cooking. I can't start your oven from here, but I can remind you at four tomorrow to put the pot on.
Person: Good. Is the oven temperature the same as the one in the book? I just want to be comfortable with it.
Assistant: Yes, it is 160 degrees. Please bring a big wooden spoon too. I will show you the recipe when you stop.

Coffee, tea and smoothies can all be made weaker or stronger, sweeter or less sweet. A drink is for waking up, cooling down or just enjoying a break. People change how strong it is, how much sugar goes in and how big the cup is. They say, make it stronger, no sugar please, or, a small soft drink with ice. A smoothie maker can draw a little fruit skin into the cup, so some people ask for the skin to be left out. A good tea takes three minutes, and people tell the assistant, set a timer for three minutes.

A package is a box or an envelope that is sent to your home. People use packages to get things they ordered, like a new humidifier, without going to a shop. A tracking number shows where the box is. People change the day it comes, where it is left and who signs for it. They say, where is my parcel, leave it with the neighbor, or, deliver it on Saturday. If a box shows up at a weird time, or a weird place, they ask the assistant to check it. The box may also say how to install the thing inside it.

It was Monday, and Ken was late for work. He ran to the car with his coffee and shouted at his phone, "Traffic news." The assistant understood he wanted a traffic report from the radio and tuned in to the local traffic station. The voice on the radio said there was a crash on the highway and told drivers to look for a different road. Ken said, "Great," which was not what he meant, and then said, "Another route." The assistant opened the map and showed him a way through the town that was ten minutes slower.

name: check_balance
does: Tells you how much money is in one of your own accounts right now, so you feel sure before you spend.
inputs: which account, like checking or savings
people say:
- how much do I have in savings
- can I afford a new tv this month
- take a quick look at my account
- what's left in checking
- tell me my balance

A flight board shows when planes leave and land, and which gate each one uses. It is for knowing where to be and when. If a plane is late, the board shows a delay and a new time. People change the flight they follow, the airport and how they want to hear about changes. They say, when does my flight leave, which gate is it, or, tell me if it is late. My dad always checks the board before he leaves home. If a flight number is lost, people dig through their email to find it. A dry, clear day usually means few delays.

Hugo was in the garden with a cup of creamy coffee on the bench. The hose began to drip onto the tomatoes, but he left it. He had a different job: his phone's password was too old. "Make my phone lock sooner," he said, "after one minute, not five." The assistant understood that he wanted the screen to lock after one minute, which is less time than before. It changed the setting, and then it asked Hugo to press the button on the side of the phone to check the lock. He pressed it, the screen went dark, and the assistant said the change was saved.

They want to lock their phone right now.
Lock my phone.
Lock it now.
Phone locked, please.
I'm getting in the bath, so please lock my phone.
Tidy up my screen and lock it.
Could you lock the phone before I walk into the local cafe?
Keep people out of my phone, lock it for now.

name: share_clip
does: Turns a saved video clip into a link that friends can open online, and measures the clip first to tell you if it is too big.
inputs: which clip, and who to send it to
people say:
- send my video to Mia
- put my dance video online
- get a link for the beach clip
- let grandma watch the video of me trying on my jeans
- how big is this clip

They want to know where their parcel is and when it will come.
Where's my parcel and when is it coming?
Track my package and tell me the date.
Can you check the parcel and say if it will come today?
I ordered a garlic press, so is it on its way and when does it land?
The tracking page is not working, so find my order and tell me when it comes.
I need the new iron before I iron shirts for the week, so where is the parcel and what day does it get here?

A playlist is a list of songs that you put together and play in order. People use playlists for a workout, a party or a quiet night. They design a playlist by picking songs, artists or a mood. They also change the volume, which works like a thermostat for sound: up when the room is loud, down when it is late. They say, play my running playlist, skip this song, turn it down, or, play something by that singer again. A salty sea song might go on a beach list. When people are done, they say, stop the music.

Person: record the front of the shop for an hour
Assistant: Sure. Which camera should I use, the door camera or the one by the till?
Person: the door one. i want to show the new bush plants we sell
Assistant: Good. The door camera will record for one hour, starting now.
Person: thats cool. can you post it on my shop page when it's done
Assistant: I'm sorry, I can't post to your shop page. I can save the video and tell you when it is ready, if you like.
Person: ok save it

Mia's taxi was waiting by the park, and she was late. She ran to the door and typed to the home app: "turn on the alram and set the cameras to medium." The assistant understood that she wanted the alarm on and the cameras at medium sensitivity, and it did both. Mia then typed, "list open windows." The assistant checked the sensors and said the kitchen window was still open. Mia ran back, shut it, and the assistant told her the house was safe. She jumped into the taxi.
